posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: Gavin Newscum’s halting the Death Penalty for all 563 California Death Row inmates, some of the worst cold blooded murderers to have ever lived on the face of the Earth, is a disaster for Justice in America. Many of these names, people who have killed, over and over again, can’t believe their luck in having a Governor so incompetent and insensitive that he would not let the long and winding legal system prevail. The family members of those who were so viciously killed are, rightfully, devastated. Hopefully this decision will be overturned! President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: Thank you to the United States Coast Guard for doing such an incredible job of rescue, and other work, having to do with the crash of the two ships in Louisiana. Likewise, all of Law Enforcement and First Responders were fantastic! Incredibly, nobody was killed by this major collision. 32 people are in the hospital. Thank you to Governor Jeff Landry for your outstanding leadership during this very agonizing period of time. President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.name: Barack Obama
posts.text: As a former commander-in-chief, I’ve had the honor of meeting with our nation’s servicemembers and military spouses over the years. Hearing their stories and seeing their courage fundamentally changes who you are, and reminds you what living your values actually looks like.
posts.text_ko: 저는 전직 총사령관으로서 수년에 걸쳐 우리나라의 장병 및 군인 배우자들을 만나는 영광을 누렸습니다. 그들의 이야기를 듣고 그들의 용기를 보는 것은 근본적으로 당신이 누구인지를 변화시키고, 당신의 가치관이 실제로 어떻게 살아가는지 상기시켜 줍니다.
